tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun rtsa gsum tshe zab las: nor sgrub kun 'khyil mched gsum bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈ rtsa gsum lha la gus pas 'dud:1$0000270 rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la: mthun rkyen zas gos nor gsum dgos: de yang myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir: gnod sbyin mched gsum sgrub pa la: phrin las snying por bsdus pa ni: gtor ma zas sna spod kyis bran: rang nyid rtsa gsum gang rung bsgom: 1$0000300mdun du skyed tshal nyams dga'i dbus: rin chen ljon shing dpangs mtho ba: me tog dmar po bkra ba'i rtsar: ut+pal dmar po nyi ma'i gdan: hrīḥyig gsum gyi 'phro 'du las: dbus su nor gyi lha mo mthing: g.yas su gos kyi lha mo ljang: g.yon du zas kyi lha mo dmar: le brgan na bza' gser rked bcings: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: sha rgyas mdzes la sgeg pa'i nyams: g.yas rnams gser gyi dgra s+t+wa dang: g.yon pas dgos 'dod mchog stsol ba'i: thod pa rin chen gang ba bsnams: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: ye shes tshogs rnams spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: dur khrod chen po'i nags tshal nas: gnod sbyin bu mo mched gsum rnams: dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: pra ti tsa ho: hūm̐: dngos su 'byor dang yid las sprul: phyi nang gsang ba mchod pa'i sprin: 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes su gsol: zas gos nor gyi dngos grub stsol: ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs/ ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā su kha pū dza ho: hūm̐: sha za'i mkha' 'gro mched gsum gyis: gtor ma bzhes la bdag gzhan kun: byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs kyi phyir: sbyin dang bsod nams tshogs kyi rdzas: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dngos grub stsol: dur khrod nags tshal shing drung chen po ru: lhag par gnas bcas sha za mkha' 'gro gsum: sgyu ma'i skur ston phrin las sgrub pa'i lha: sna tshogs mdzad pa yid bzhin nor 'dra zhing: dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba skong:

mi zad gter gyi bum bzang mdzod 'dzin pa: dgos 'dod mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgrub cing bzlas pa gzhan du shes: gshegs shing rten la bstim pa sogs: rnal 'byor rang gis gang 'dod bya: 'dis ni longs spyod myur du 'du: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000250༁ྃ: zab bdun rtsa gsum tshe zab las: kun 'khyil mched gsum sgrub thabs bzhugs: 1$0000300rtsa gsum lha la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000270 gnod sbyin mched gsum sgrub pa'i rten: 'gron bu bu yod hrīḥs mtshan pa: khong du sngags kyi byang bu bcug: le brgan gyis dril dar snas bcings: lha klu mi gsum bla rdo dang: rin chen 'bru sman rta phyugs spu: zas sna rnams dang lhan cig tu: rin thang che ba'i gwa 'ur bstsal: da la bris pa'i sku rten bcas: bgegs bskrad khrus kyis sbyang bar bya: de nyid lha mo gsum du mos: 1$0000300rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: gnod sbyin bu mo'i thugs rgyud bskul: hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs: 'khor 'das kun tu 'phros pa yis: mkhyen ldan 'byor ldan bsod nams can: dbang thang can gyi tshe bsod dpal: zas gos nor rnams thams cad kun: gnas 'dir bsdus shing thim par bsam:1$0000250 sngags 'di thugs kar bkod cing bzla: 1$0000300oṃ i ling ki: pi ling ki: ki ling ki swā hā:1$0000250 gos kyi lha mo'o: 1$0000300oṃ na mo shu tra mu tri ma hā pi shā tsi na ye swā hā:1$0000250 nor gyi lha mo'o: 1$0000300oṃ a na le: kun dha le: gṛh+ṇa: pi ṇa dha: pi shā tsi na ye swā hā:1$0000250 zas kyi lha mo'o: sa ma ya: rgyaḥrgya: zhag gcig gis 'grub pa'i sngags sham 'di sbyar ro: 1$0000300 ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ sa ma ya: rgyaḥrgyaḥ 1$0000250༁ྃ: yang zab rtsa gsum tshe zab las: gnod sbyin spun gsum bka' gtad bzhugs: 1$0000300rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: sha za mkha' 'gro spun gsum gyi:

sgrub la dbang ba'i bka' gtad ni: dkyil 'khor ut+pal gsum bri 'am: me tog sil mas tshom bu bkram: thod bzang nang du gtor ma ni: rin chen dbyibs can dgra s+t+was mtshan: zas snas bskor la spod kyis bran: bag dro rgyan ldan dar gur phub: ku sha'i chun po gsum yang btsugs: de la lha mo'i sku gzugs btags: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsham: sgrub pa'i phrin las tshul bzhin btang: bum par rigs gsum mgon po bskyed: snying po bzlas pas 'od zhu bsam: slob mas rten 'brel che ba'i rdzas: tshogs gsag phyir na maṇ+ḍal 'bul: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pa'i: bla ma sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: byang chub lam gyi mthun rkyen kun: bsgrub phyir lha mo'i rjes gnang stsol: rgyud sbyang sku yi lha mor bskyed: ye shes bstim zhing bum dbang bskur: til gyi gong bu sogs/mchan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dbu brgyan bsam: sku gzugs gtor ma spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi sprul pa ste: sgrub pa po la gos kyi dngos grub stsol: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khyod kyis dam bcas ltar: zhal bzhes bzhin du dngos grub 'grub par mdzod: sngags kyi dbang bskur bzlas lung sbyin: lha mo rang sems dbyer med bsam: de bzhin zas kyi lha mor bskyed: spyan ras gzigs kyis dbur brgyan bsam: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi sprul pa ste: sgrub pa po la zas kyi dngos grub stsol: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khyod kyis dam bcas ltar: zhal bzhes bzhin du dngos grub 'grub par mdzod: nor gyi lha mo'i dbu rgyan yang: phyag na rdo rje nyid du bya: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi sprul pa ste: sgrub pa po la nor gyi dngos grub stsol: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khyod kyis dam bcas ltar: zhal bzhes bzhin du dngos grub 'grub par mdzod: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bya: rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar la:

rten gtor mdzod kyi phugs su sba: longs spyod rgyas pa'i rten 'brel lo: sa ma ya rgya: lha sras mu rub btsad po'i rnam rol sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams yel brag nam mkha' mdzod nas las ldan gyi grogs dang bcas pas spyan drangs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga shog o rgyan phyag bris las/ sa spyod gsung gi 'khor lo 'og min karma'i gdan sa chen po'i ri khrod bde chen gling du me sbrul lo tha skar zla ba'i yar ngo gu ru rin po che'i dus chen tshes bcu'i snga dro'i char dbu brtsams nas phab rim bzhin du/ zur mang bstan 'dzin sprul ming pa pad+ma nges gsang bstan pa rab rgyas kyis bris pa dge'o/// /
